# Space Junk Defender

Control a spaceship at the bottom of an HTML canvas. Meteors (space junk) fall from the top; click or drag to move the ship and fire a shield to block them. Each meteor that hits the ship reduces health, and after three hits the player loses. Earn points for each blocked meteor and try to survive as long as possible.

<content>
1: // Simple Space Junk Defender game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // create star field
8:   // audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'square';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
20:   }
21:   const starCount = 100;
22:   const stars = [];
23:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
24:     stars.push({
25:       x: Math.random() * width,
26:       y: Math.random() * height,
27:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
28:     });
29:   }
30:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
31:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
32: 
33:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2, y: height - 30, speed: 0 };
34:   let shield = false;
35:   let health = 3;
36:   let score = 0;
37:   const meteors = [];
38:   let lastSpawn = 0;
39: 
40:   // Input handling – click/drag moves ship, mouse down activates shield
41:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
42:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
43:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
44:   });
45:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { shield = true; playTone(400, 0.1); });
46:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { shield = false; });
47: 
48:   function spawnMeteor() {
49:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 15;
50:     meteors.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, vy: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update(dt) {
54:     // spawn every 800ms
55:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > 800) { spawnMeteor(); lastSpawn = Date.now(); }
56:     // update stars (slow drift)
57:     stars.forEach(s => {
58:       s.y += 0.2;
59:       if (s.y > height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * width; }
60:     });
61:     // move meteors
62:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
63:       const m = meteors[i];
64:       m.y += m.vy;
65:       // collision with ship
66:       const dx = Math.abs(m.x + m.r - ship.x);
67:       const dy = Math.abs(m.y + m.r - ship.y);
68:       const coll = dx < ship.w / 2 && dy < ship.h / 2;
69:       if (coll) {
70:         if (shield) { score++; meteors.splice(i, 1); continue; }
71:         health--; meteors.splice(i, 1); if (health <= 0) { gameOver(); return; }
72:       } else if (m.y - m.r > height) {
73:         meteors.splice(i, 1); // missed
74:       }
75:     }
76:   }
77: 
78:   function draw() {
79:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
80:     // background gradient
81:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
82:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
83:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
84:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
85:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
86:     // stars
87:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
88:     stars.forEach(s => {
89:       ctx.beginPath();
90:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
91:       ctx.fill();
92:     });
93:     // ship - draw as triangle
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // shield
102:     if (shield) {
103:       ctx.beginPath();
104:       ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, 0, Math.PI * 2);
105:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.5)';
106:       ctx.lineWidth = 4;
107:       ctx.stroke();
108:     }
109:     // meteors
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
111:     meteors.forEach(m => {
112:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
113:         m.x + m.r,
114:         m.y + m.r,
115:         0,
116:         m.x + m.r,
117:         m.y + m.r,
118:         m.r
119:       );
120:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ddd');
121:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
122:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
123:       ctx.beginPath();
124:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.r, m.y + m.r, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     });
127:     // UI
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
129:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
130:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
131:     ctx.fillText(`Health: ${health}`, 10, 40);
132:   }
133: 
134:   let lastTime = 0;
135:   function loop(timestamp) {
136:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
137:     lastTime = timestamp;
138:     update(dt);
139:     draw();
140:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141:   }
142:   let running = true;
143:   function gameOver() {
144:     running = false;
145:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
146:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
147:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f33';
148:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
149:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
151:   }
152: 
153:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154: })();

(End of file - total 154 lines)
</content>
